name: bandit.r027_physical_signal_bootstrap_mcw
description: Zero-credit R-027 setup: leave the autoloaded overmap explicitly, prove the local gameplay HUD, place one physical fire, and persist its exact saved-map location for a separately authorized observation.

steps.label: loaded_r027_local_hud_before_overmap_transition
steps.expected_visible_fact: the isolated R-027 world has loaded at a verified local gameplay HUD before the explicit map-mode transition

steps.label: open_r027_overmap_before_returning_local
steps.expected_visible_fact: the ordinary overmap is explicitly open before its return to the local HUD

steps.label: return_from_overmap_to_local_hud
steps.expected_visible_fact: the explicitly opened overmap has returned to the local gameplay HUD before field placement

steps.label: verify_r027_debug_menu_binding
steps.abort_reason: the scenario-scoped Debug binding did not visibly open the native Debug menu before field placement
steps.expected_visible_fact: the native Debug menu is visibly open through the scenario-scoped debug binding before field placement

steps.label: close_r027_verified_debug_menu_before_field_command
steps.expected_visible_fact: the verified native Debug menu is closed before the field-placement command reopens it

steps.label: stage_r027_physical_fire_before_scheduler
steps.expected_visible_fact: a physical fd_fire field is placed exactly one local-map square west of the player without advancing the scheduler
steps.failure_rule: This is explicit setup and has zero signal-observation, lead, dispatch, or gameplay credit.

steps.label: audit_r027_physical_fire_save_before_writeback
steps.expected_visible_fact: saved-player mtime baseline is captured before preserving the setup field

steps.label: request_r027_physical_fire_setup_save
steps.abort_reason: the native Save-and-Quit confirmation did not open after physical setup
steps.expected_visible_fact: save-and-quit is visibly requested after the zero-credit setup mutation

steps.label: confirm_r027_physical_fire_setup_save
steps.expected_visible_fact: the setup save is confirmed before the field source is read back

steps.label: audit_r027_physical_fire_save_after_writeback
steps.abort_reason: the field setup was not durably written before a later observation could consume it
steps.expected_visible_fact: saved-player mtime advanced after confirming the zero-credit setup save

steps.label: audit_r027_physical_fire_source_after_save
steps.abort_reason: the exact saved source tile west of the player did not retain fd_fire after setup writeback
steps.expected_visible_fact: the saved audit names the exact target_location_ms/target_abs_omt of the physical fd_fire source for the later independent observation
